correctness.rationale: The normalized polar Lipschitz polytope vertex criterion follows from active incidence rank. Tight connectedness forces integer potentials and, by bipartite parity, all 21 edges to be tight. Point-line Fano incidence gives an exhaustive two-envelope parameterization: the number of monochromatic lines is 7-k(7-k)/2 and the sum 2*394-128=660. The level distribution follows from Fano line intersection, and exhaustive exact finite enumeration gives the ten disjoint orbits and their representatives. The stored program was executed successfully on the actual code path.

value.rationale: This is a complete, reproducible classification of facets and graph symmetry orbits of the canonical 13-dimensional real transportation-norm ball of the Heawood/Fano incidence metric, not a special substitution in a known closed formula. Its ten orbit types, representatives, 660 count, level spectrum and 21-vertex facet incidences quantify previously unevaluated structure of a natural highly symmetric nonplanar graph metric.
